To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the message content, the frequency of message exposure, the perceived usefulness and the perceived privacy are important determinants of the perceived advertising value of m-advertising.

the perceived advertising value is higher for consumers who are more likely to receive mobile advertising messages, who perceive the messages to be relevant to their interests and to be of high quality.
mobile advertising has a positive impact on the perceived advertising value of the mobile device and that the message content has the greatest impact on the perceived value.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a topic of great importance for marketing practice.
the advertising value of mobile devices, which is a topic that has not been sufficiently investigated so far.
the question how to make m-advertising more attractive for consumers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the advertising value of mobile communication can be increased by providing relevant content and avoiding a high frequency of messages.
m-advertising can only be successful if the message is relevant for the consumer.
mobile marketing can be used as an efficient and effective marketing instrument to reach consumers with individualized and personalized advertising messages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mobile advertising is an interesting tool for marketers.

the perceived advertising value of a m-advertising campaign can be enhanced by providing a message content that is relevant and useful for the consumer and by reducing the frequency of message exposure.
the perceived advertising value is a key determinant of m-advertising.
The main takeaway from our work is that
m-advertising has to offer more than traditional advertising.
the message content has the highest impact on the perceived advertising value of m-advertising, followed by message relevance and the frequency of message exposure.
the message content should be adapted to the individual user and that a high message frequency should be avoided.
